Recorded claim:
Use atomic `setCalendarEventRoute({ calendarId, eventId, recurrenceId })` rather than piecemeal route attributes: it prevents transient incomplete routes and clears stale recurrence IDs when the replacement is non-recurring. The resolved create/edit conflict retained this shared-loader behavior and the newer serializable draft/session model; build, draft-state xpcshell (20/20), and create/edit browser coverage (47/47) passed. [Task 4]
